note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md (2026-11-27): 16 pictures chosen from 32 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088). Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. God is not pictured; Abram, Sarai, Lot and the others are only ordinary people of today, seen from behind or small. Fixed recurring objects: Abram's tent is a small plain weathered tan canvas tent on a simple wooden pole frame; the altar is a small altar of stacked rough fieldstones; the oak is one huge old oak with a broad gnarled trunk and a wide dark-green crown.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning; (2) write picture ideas for each; (3) judge them; (4) make the top two for each slot as real pictures and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Yahweh's word comes to Abram in a vision: a shield and a great reward; Abram is childless; the stars show the offspring to come; Abram trusts.
Yahweh promises the land, Abram asks how he will know, and prepares the animals, driving the birds of prey off.
A deep sleep, terror and darkness: four hundred years away in a land not theirs, then out with great possessions; Abram dies in peace.
A smoking oven and a flaming torch pass between the pieces; Yahweh makes a covenant giving the land from the river of Egypt to the Euphrates.

scenes.principle: After these things the word of Yahweh came to Abram in a vision, saying, "Do not be afraid, Abram. I am a shield to you; your reward will be very great."

The tent and the overhang are in the upper part of the frame. The subject and every important detail are in the upper part of the frame.
